d:
India’s listed automakers have grown their domestic revenue at about 11% a year over the past decade, and nearly every vehicle they sell passes through a family-owned dealership. Saurabh Mukherjea and Nandita Rajhansa of Marcellus Investment Managers explain why serving small-town customers and operating at multi-outlet scale make auto dealerships one of the most reliable sources of local wealth, and what risks lie ahead as India moves to electric vehicles.
